answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 52723 Country: India Title: Dreams Question: I want to have interpretation of three dreams. (1) One night I saw Hadhrat Omar (RA) comes for a janazah. I was also there. I did not see his face. Also I could not remember whether janazah was performed or not. (2) I am an aeronautical engineer. One night I saw lots of small planes are landing. They were landing so fast that I wondered there could be accident. And then I saw one big jet plane was coming. (3) One night I saw a very pious old man known to me is saying to me that he is writing a taweez for me so that I shall be rich. Answer ID: 52723 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 763/781/N=07/1435) (1) May Allah give me, you and all the Muslims zeal and enthusiasm in faith like Hadhrat Umar (رضي الله عنه). Ma-shaAllah, your dream is blessed one and shows your special love with Hadhrat Umar (رضي الله عنه). (2) The dream indicates that the world is progressing on a high speed and the Day of Judgment is approaching very fast. Hence you should not be fascinated by the colourful world rather prepare for the hereafter and pay special attention towards it. (3) In-shaAllah, you shall abound in wealth and children by doing excessive istighfar and adopting taqwa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
